principle: Generated civilization visuals resolve from persistent biology + environment + technology + culture + institution + individual identity.
rules: No visual generation before required world-state authorities exist.
A species face/body design, once materialized, becomes persistent morphology canon for that generated species.
Culture may shape clothing/architecture but cannot overwrite biology.
Technology level constrains fabrication, materials, vehicles and architecture.
A divided world may have multiple visual cultures/states under one civilization.
First Contact portrait generation must reuse persistent representative NPC visual_identity_id.
Image generation cannot invent badges, writing, government symbols or technology absent from resolved state.
nap_rule: Prompt/asset metadata must carry civilization_id, species_id, culture_ref, era/date, visual_identity_id where individual-backed, and provenance.
